title: Receive a compliment
description: Hear a compliment and respond without cancelling it.
oneStarDescription: Let the person finish the compliment.
twoStarDescription: Thank them without insulting the thing they praised.
threeStarDescription: If you want to know more, ask one question, or stop at the thanks.

title: Record the name of a piece you liked
description: Write the name of a work you liked and one reason, so you can find it again.
oneStarDescription: Copy the title and the maker from the label.
twoStarDescription: Add one reason that points to something you saw or heard.
threeStarDescription: Later, use your note to find the work in a catalog or say the note was not enough and fix it.

title: Reduce glare on a screen
description: Move a screen or a light so you can see the content.
oneStarDescription: Point to the reflection that hides the content.
twoStarDescription: Move the screen, the light, or your seat, and show that the content is easier to see.
threeStarDescription: If it is still hard to see, say what you would change next, or that you would stop.

title: Rehang a curtain ring
description: Put a curtain ring back on its rod so the curtain hangs with the others.
oneStarDescription: Find the missing ring and the place it left.
twoStarDescription: Put the ring on the rod and the curtain on the ring.
threeStarDescription: Slide the curtain and say whether the rings move, and stop if the rod comes down.

title: Replace a shoelace
description: Thread a new lace so both shoes match and the ends do not pull out.
oneStarDescription: Remove one lace and keep the path it used.
twoStarDescription: Thread a new lace along that path so the ends come out even.
threeStarDescription: Do the second shoe the same way, or say you are leaving it until you have a second lace.

title: Report something broken in a public place
description: Report a broken bench, a light, or a similar public thing to the office that handles it.
oneStarDescription: Write what is broken and where, with a landmark.
twoStarDescription: Send the note through the official path you found, not a random link.
threeStarDescription: Save any reference number, or say the path gave you none.

title: Return a borrowed thing
description: Return something you borrowed in the condition you agreed, and say if it changed.
oneStarDescription: When you borrow it, note one fact about its condition.
twoStarDescription: Return it by the time you agreed.
threeStarDescription: If it changed, say how, and ask what they want done.

title: Rewrite a notice in plain language
description: Rewrite a short official notice so a reader can say what they must do.
oneStarDescription: Underline what the reader is supposed to do, and by when, if a time is printed.
twoStarDescription: Rewrite that action in words a friend can repeat, without adding a rule that was not in the notice.
threeStarDescription: Ask someone what they would do next, and fix the sentence if they name the wrong action.

title: Run a brainstorm
description: Collect ideas from a group before anyone ranks them.
oneStarDescription: Write one question and say that ranking comes later.
twoStarDescription: Write every idea offered, and stop a critique until the list is done.
threeStarDescription: Read the list back and say which step, such as clustering, has not happened yet.

title: Seat people so they can see
description: Arrange a few seats so each person can see the front, and move one that cannot.
oneStarDescription: Set seats facing the front.
twoStarDescription: Sit in the worst seat and say whether the front is visible.
threeStarDescription: Move a seat that fails, or say there is no better place.

title: Send sound along a string
description: Send a voice along a tight string and show that a slack string fails.
oneStarDescription: Stretch a string between two cups or cans and speak quietly into one.
twoStarDescription: Have someone hear the other end, then slacken the string and try again.
threeStarDescription: Say one reason this is not a telephone, such as distance or a broken line.

title: Separate a simple mixture
description: Separate a mixture of two safe materials with a sieve or a magnet.
oneStarDescription: Look at a mixture of two safe materials and say whether you will use a sieve or a magnet, and why.
twoStarDescription: Carry out that method and show two piles that are mostly one material each.
threeStarDescription: Point to what is still mixed and say you are not claiming a pure sample.

title: Separate a fact from a recommendation
description: In a short text, mark a fact and a recommendation.
oneStarDescription: Mark a sentence that reports something you could check.
twoStarDescription: Mark a sentence that tells the reader what to do or buy.
threeStarDescription: If the text has only one of those, say which is missing.

title: Set a clock after it lost time
description: Set a clock to a time source you can name, including the date if it shows one.
oneStarDescription: Name the time source you will trust, such as an official clock.
twoStarDescription: Set the clock, including the date if it drifted.
threeStarDescription: If it has an alarm you rely on, show that the alarm time is still the one you want.

title: Set a rule for a shared playlist
description: Agree how a shared playlist works, then add one track that follows the rule.
oneStarDescription: Write who may add tracks and what kind of track fits.
twoStarDescription: Add one track that fits, with the title and the artist.
threeStarDescription: If someone adds a track that breaks the rule, ask before you remove it, or leave it and note the break.

title: Lay out tools for a task
description: Lay out only the tools a task needs, in the order you will use them.
oneStarDescription: List the tools the task needs before you fetch extras.
twoStarDescription: Put them in the order you will use them, with handles toward you.
threeStarDescription: Put away a tool you did not use, and say why it was extra.

title: Sew a visible patch
description: Sew a patch over a small hole so the patch covers the damage.
oneStarDescription: Pin a patch that extends past the hole on every side.
twoStarDescription: Sew around the patch and fasten the thread.
threeStarDescription: Look at the back and restitch a gap, or say the hole is still open and you are not done.

title: Share a mistake so others can avoid it
description: Tell others about a mistake you made, the cause, and the check that would catch it.
oneStarDescription: Say what you did and what happened.
twoStarDescription: Name the check that would have caught it.
threeStarDescription: Tell it without blaming a person who is not there, and invite one question.

title: Share a place pin
description: Send a place pin and check that the other person opened the same place.
oneStarDescription: Send a pin or a map link for a place you both may visit.
twoStarDescription: Ask them to read back the place name.
threeStarDescription: If they see the wrong place, send a landmark or a corrected pin.

title: Show a lever at work
description: Use a lever to lift a light load and say where the pivot is.
oneStarDescription: Set a ruler or a bar on a pivot and lift a small object.
twoStarDescription: Move the pivot and say whether the lift felt easier or harder.
threeStarDescription: Point to a door handle, a bottle opener, or another everyday lever and name the pivot.

title: Show a prop
description: Hold an object so a watcher can see it, then pass or set it down on purpose.
oneStarDescription: Hold the object still long enough for a watcher to say what it is.
twoStarDescription: Turn it if they say a hand is covering it, and show it again.
threeStarDescription: Set it on an agreed place so the next person can find it.

title: Use a window as a light source
description: Place work near a window and say when the daylight is not enough.
oneStarDescription: Place the work where daylight falls on it.
twoStarDescription: Turn the work if you are in your own shadow.
threeStarDescription: If the daylight fades, add a lamp or stop, and say which.

title: Show where the toilets are
description: Tell or show a guest where the toilet is, including any step.
oneStarDescription: Check the way yourself before you send them.
twoStarDescription: Explain the turns, and mention a step if there is one.
threeStarDescription: Offer to walk with them, and stay if they say no.

title: Silence a hinge as the label says
description: Quiet a hinge using only a product whose label says it can be used on a hinge.
oneStarDescription: Show the label that names hinges or moving metal, and the amount.
twoStarDescription: Apply only that amount and wipe the excess.
threeStarDescription: Open the door and say whether the squeak is quieter, and stop if the door will not latch.

title: Sketch a screen on paper
description: Sketch a screen on paper and say what each part does before any software.
oneStarDescription: Draw the main regions of one screen and label them.
twoStarDescription: Point to the one action the screen is for.
threeStarDescription: Tell a person what they would tap or read first, and change a label they do not understand.

title: Slow your speech when asked
description: Slow down and repeat a sentence when a listener asks, without adding new content.
oneStarDescription: When asked, repeat the same sentence more slowly.
twoStarDescription: Split the sentence into two parts and pause between them.
threeStarDescription: Ask the listener to say back the part they needed, and repeat only that part if they missed it.

title: Sort recycling by the sign in front of you
description: Sort items using the categories on the bin or the local sign, not a general rule.
oneStarDescription: Read the categories on the bins where you are.
twoStarDescription: Put each item in a named category, or set it aside if it is not listed.
threeStarDescription: Show one item you did not put in, and the reason the sign does not list it.

title: Split a word into parts
description: Split a long word into parts and say what each part does, using a dictionary when you need it.
oneStarDescription: Mark the parts of a long word you can justify.
twoStarDescription: Check one part in a dictionary and correct your split if needed.
threeStarDescription: Use the word in a sentence that would fail if you had the parts wrong.

title: Spot a repeated instruction
description: In a set of instructions, find a step that is said twice and might conflict.
oneStarDescription: Read a short set of instructions you are allowed to study.
twoStarDescription: Find two sentences that tell you to do the same thing, or say there is no repeat.
threeStarDescription: If they differ, say how, and which one you would ask about before doing the task.

title: Stack a stable pile
description: Stack books or boxes so the pile is smaller at the top and does not lean.
oneStarDescription: Put the largest or heaviest at the bottom.
twoStarDescription: Add items only while the pile does not lean, and stop when it does.
threeStarDescription: Take the pile down from the top.

title: Stay in the role you were given
description: At an appointment or a meeting, do only the task the person asked of you.
oneStarDescription: Before you go in, restate the task they gave you.
twoStarDescription: During the meeting, decline a task they did not ask for, or ask them before you take it.
threeStarDescription: Afterward, ask what they want remembered, and do not tell others their business.

title: Steady a wobble you can see
description: Stop a small wobble with a pad or by moving the object, and say if the frame is the problem.
oneStarDescription: Rock the object and point to the foot that leaves the floor.
twoStarDescription: Add a pad or move the object so it sits quieter.
threeStarDescription: If the frame is cracked or the wobble remains, say you will not force it.

title: Stop at a timebox
description: Work until a time you set, then stop and say what is unfinished.
oneStarDescription: Write the end time before you start.
twoStarDescription: Stop at that time even if you want to continue.
threeStarDescription: Write what is unfinished, separate from what is done.

title: Summarize a written thread
description: Summarize a written thread so a new reader knows the decision and the open question.
oneStarDescription: Read the thread and write any decision it contains.
twoStarDescription: Write the question that is still open, or say there is none.
threeStarDescription: Ask one participant if the summary missed a decision, and fix it if it did.

title: Switch roles in a pair
description: Do a task in a pair, then switch who leads and who checks.
oneStarDescription: Say who leads and who checks before you start.
twoStarDescription: Switch roles for the next part of the task.
threeStarDescription: Each person says one thing they noticed in the other role.

title: Take a cue
description: Enter or speak when a cue happens, not before.
oneStarDescription: Agree the cue, a word or an action, before the run.
twoStarDescription: Stay still until the cue, then do the action.
threeStarDescription: If you miss it, take the next agreed chance or stop and reset, and say which.

title: Take a soundwalk
description: Walk a short way and note the sounds without recording anyone's private talk.
oneStarDescription: Walk a short route and write three sounds you heard.
twoStarDescription: Say which sound was near, which was far, and which you could not place.
threeStarDescription: If you heard a private conversation, do not write the words, and say you left them out.

title: Tap a rhythm and repeat it
description: Tap a short rhythm, then repeat it the same way.
oneStarDescription: Tap a short pattern and stop.
twoStarDescription: Repeat the same pattern once.
threeStarDescription: Ask someone to tap it back, and say whether they matched it.

title: Teach a hand position
description: Show a hand position for a craft or a piece of music and correct one visible difference.
oneStarDescription: Show the position on your own hand and name what matters.
twoStarDescription: Watch the other person try, and name one difference you can see.
threeStarDescription: Show the adjustment once, then let them decide whether it feels usable.

title: Tell damp ground from dry
description: Look at and feel the ground and say whether it is damp, and what you will not infer.
oneStarDescription: Look at the color and the sheen of the ground.
twoStarDescription: Touch the surface and say whether it is damp.
threeStarDescription: Say you cannot tell how deep the water goes, or whether it is safe to cross.
